components.name: Two-basin integer quotient/root transport
components.project_addition: Combine the canonical square-collapse basin with exact natural-number floor division to prove a two-adjacent-root quotient image with strict base-root descent; flatten multi-stage divisor paths to one product divisor using established Euclidean quotient composition; prove strict actual root descent for k>=3; and sharpen the remaining binary branch to one exact state/offset threshold, so families of quotient-root bits are driven by one shared basin coordinate rather than independent choices. The project-specific content is the square-basin compatibility, path-flat two-basin consequence, strict root descent, and exact shared-offset threshold response; Nat.nthRoot, floor-division order lemmas, and Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul are established formal tools.
